runs.description: All benchmark runs with their status, SUT version, environment and tags. Filter by any dimension and open a run for its details.

compare.description: Compare runs, client devices or parameter values side by side, with absolute and relative differences against a reference.

trends.description: Follow a metric of one case on one client device across runs, over time or over SUT versions.

series.description: Overlay series from different samples and runs, resample and aggregate them.

suites.description: The suites and scenarios the harness uploads, with all their versions, and the test cases of a scenario. Look up what a version changed, and tag or annotate test cases.

metrics.description: The uploaded metrics with their unit and direction, and the unit catalogue. A metric has one definition, which can be changed here.

derivedMetrics.description: Define derived metrics in the DSL and change them when needed. They are computed at query time, also for historical runs.

aliases.description: Rename or merge device names, parameter values and other dimension values. Aliases apply everywhere.

tokens.description: API tokens for the benchmark harness and MCP clients. Create and revoke them here.

units.customText: Metrics use these units, but they are not in the catalogue. Their values are shown as uploaded and not converted.
units.error: The unit catalogue could not be loaded: {{message}}

functions.abs: Absolute value, of a scalar or point by point.
functions.log10: Base-10 logarithm; the result is dimensionless.
functions.min: With several arguments: the smallest, point by point. With one series: its smallest y in [from, to].
functions.max: With several arguments: the largest, point by point. With one series: its largest y in [from, to].
functions.clamp: Limits a value to the range [lo, hi].
functions.mean: Mean y of a series in [from, to].
functions.auc: Area under the curve in [from, to]; the unit is y·x.
functions.time_to: First x (from `from` on) where y reaches the threshold. No value if it never does.
functions.rate: Change of y per x (derivative); the unit is y/x.
functions.log10_x: The series with log10 of its x values.
functions.moving_avg: Trailing mean over a window in x units.
functions.rekey: y over another series of the same sample as x, e.g. quality over bytes received.

reference.metric: An uploaded scalar metric of the same sample.

reference.derived: Another derived metric. A later change to it applies here too.
reference.quoted: A name with other characters, in backticks.
reference.unit: A number with a unit. Without one it takes the unit its context needs.
reference.operators: Arithmetic; units must fit (+ and − need convertible units).
reference.noValue: Bounds (from=, to=) are constants or scalars of the same sample. interp=linear (default) or interp=step. A result that cannot be computed is no value, which is not missing data.
